name: in-toto Attestation Framework
installation: Specification does not require a service. Implement Statement v1 with a documented application predicate; optional language bindings are separate.
dependencies: JSON serializer; cryptographic signer required separately for authenticity
sdk: Go/Python/Rust/Java bindings documented; Python package in-toto-attestation 0.9.3 inspected on PyPI
cli: No attestation CLI established by this specification repository
output_formats: Optional DSSE envelope when actually signed
licence: Apache-2.0. Other predicate specifications may have separate licences.
maintenance_status: Specification latest release v1.2.0; inspected v1 statement/envelope documents. README warns tooling is still under development.
recommended_integration: Generate and structurally validate Statement v1 for evidence digest; mark unsigned until an actual signer signs and a verifier succeeds.
security_risks: Unsigned statements do not establish identity or authenticity
Do not relabel custom predicates as SLSA provenance
Subject digest must bind exact bytes
integration_test_status: EXECUTED: application-owned Statement v1 and Ed25519 DSSE signing/verification; tampered payload, digest, subject identity and unavailable key rejected. This is not a Cosign or Sigstore interoperability claim.
verification_method: Official commit-pinned README, licence and listed source files; git ls-remote HEAD; GitHub latest release redirect and PyPI metadata when applicable. GitHub REST API unavailable due to shared anonymous rate limit.
